cases.name: two-log-signatures
cases.why: receipt.note with a second line under the log's name and key id whose signature does not verify: a reader that accepts the note once one line verifies, or never verifies it at all, accepts it

cases.name: extension-line
cases.why: the honest four lines and a fifth, re-signed: a reader that reads the four lines it expects and ignores the rest accepts it

cases.name: wrong-version
cases.why: the first line names version 2, re-signed: a reader that never looks at the first line accepts it

cases.name: origin-with-a-suffix
cases.why: this network's origin plus one base32 character, re-signed: a reader that accepts an origin line extending this network's accepts it

cases.name: origin-in-upper-case
cases.why: this network's origin with its base32 in upper case, re-signed: a reader that folds case accepts it

cases.name: origin-truncated
cases.why: this network's origin less its last character, re-signed: a reader that accepts an origin line this network's origin extends accepts it

cases.name: leaf-hash-too-long
cases.why: the leaf hash line decodes to 33 bytes whose first 32 are the honest leaf hash, re-signed: a reader that takes the first 32, or never checks the length, accepts it

cases.name: deadline-leading-zero
cases.why: the deadline line with a leading zero, re-signed: the same number to a reader that parses it as an integer, and not canonical decimal

cases.name: deadline-plus-sign
cases.why: the deadline line with a plus sign, re-signed: the same number to a signed parser, and not ASCII digits

cases.name: deadline-above-uint64
cases.why: a deadline of 2^64, re-signed: canonical decimal, and one more than the cosignature timestamps it is compared with can carry

cases.name: leaf-hash-too-short
cases.why: the leaf hash line decodes to 31 bytes, the honest leaf hash less its last byte, re-signed: a reader that zero-fills a short leaf accepts it

cases.name: leaf-hash-unpadded
cases.why: the leaf hash line without its padding, re-signed: a decoder that accepts unpadded base64 reads the honest leaf from it

cases.name: leaf-hash-non-canonical-pad-bits
cases.why: the leaf hash line with a non-zero padding bit in its last data character, re-signed: a decoder that ignores padding bits reads the honest leaf from it, and this line is not the leaf's encoding

cases.name: leaf-hash-carriage-return
cases.why: the leaf hash line with a carriage return inside it, re-signed: a decoder that skips control characters reads the honest leaf from it

comment: every .note here MUST be refused as a receipt (SPEC 7). Read each exactly as receipt.note is read, which MUST be accepted: under trust.cbor's log_key and origin, with no entry in hand and no clock, since whether the leaf is yours and whether the deadline has passed are the holder's questions and not properties of the file. Each but two-log-signatures is receipt.note with one line changed or added and re-signed by the log key, so its signature verifies; two-log-signatures is receipt.note itself plus a forged copy of its signature line

two-log-signatures.says: every line whose name and key id match MUST verify
